summary: Stage-accurate names for the ide detection locals in koruide ide

delivery.outcome: Clear the code2llm Shotgun Surgery smell for the variable 'ide' in packages/koruide/src/koruide/ide.py (planfile ticket PLF-043, reported at line 640; ticket-evidence file sha256 5740df5c... matches the working file, so the report is current) by renaming each of the five same-named locals to the detection stage that produces it. Five functions assign a local 'ide': detect_focused_ide_id (line 454, focused-window pid mapped to an IDE id), _terminal_ide_from_env_with_source (line 650, first element of the _vscode_family_terminal_ide(chrome_ide) unpack), _terminal_ide_from_env (line 675, first element of the _terminal_ide_from_env_with_source() unpack), detect_terminal_host_ide_id (line 732) and detect_terminal_host_context (line 750, both binding the _terminal_ide_from_parent_chain(start) result). As in the PLF-039/PLF-041 lanes, these are five different detection stages that coincidentally reuse the generic name - naming coincidence, not one coupled variable - so the fix is per-site stage-accurate renaming, not centralization: focused_ide_id (detect_focused_ide_id), family_ide (_terminal_ide_from_env_with_source, alongside the existing brand/flavor family locals), env_ide (_terminal_ide_from_env), from_chain (detect_terminal_host_ide_id and detect_terminal_host_context, parallel to the from_env local already used in both functions for the env-detected result). One additional gate-driven rename in the same file: normalize_ide_id's local 'token' -> 'alias' (matching the _IDE_ALIASES mapping consumed right below), because the GOV-SECRET-001 scanner (keyword 'token' followed by an assignment sign and a 12+ character word-run) false-positives on the pre-existing chained self-assignment around the rsplit basename strip in that function, and that check runs per changed file in the pytest GOV-PACKAGING-003 gate, pre-commit and CI - no prior commit has touched this file since the check exists, so any lane touching it is hard-blocked until the rename; the file has zero raw scanner hits afterwards. The code2llm shotgun-surgery detector groups mutations by (file, variable) and fires at >= 5 scopes; the 'ide' group drops from 5 scopes to 0, from_chain lands at 2, family_ide/env_ide/focused_ide_id at 1 each and alias at 1 (normalize_ide_id). No behavior change: pure local-identifier renames - identical expressions, call order, return values and public signatures; the ide= keyword arguments to TerminalHostContext(...) are constructor field names, not variable mutations, and are untouched. No duplication.toon.yaml exists in this checkout, so the duplication-report checklist has nothing to consult for the touched path.
nonGoals: No behavior, call-order, logging-format or signature change; every renamed local keeps its exact expression and every public function keeps its interface

No touching of the pre-existing separate 'normalized' mutation group in the same file (6 scopes: canonical_autopilot_ide_id, ide_binary_candidates, ide_window_name, normalize_ide_id, resolve_drive_target, supports_vscode_extension_plugin) - a different variable and dedupe key that needs its own ticket
No restructuring of the terminal-IDE detection cascade or its precedence; only local identifiers change
No waiver, skip or plugin disable for the GOV-SECRET-001 gate: the scanner false positive is resolved by the stage-accurate token->alias rename, not by bypassing the check
No changes to other modules' 'ide' locals - they are separate files with their own mutation grouping and not part of this reported dedupe key

architecture.decision: Per-site stage-accurate renames inside the same module. The five 'ide' bindings come from five different detection stages (focused-window pid mapping, VS Code-family env cascade, env-only wrapper, and two parent-chain consumers), so there is no shared resolution stage to centralize - unlike the PLF-042 lane where the identical unpack justified a _resolve_lane helper. Renaming each local to its stage (focused_ide_id, family_ide, env_ide, from_chain) both dissolves the (file, variable) mutation group and makes each function read as its own detection stage; from_chain deliberately mirrors the from_env local already present in detect_terminal_host_ide_id / detect_terminal_host_context for the other detection route; normalize_ide_id's token->alias rename additionally clears the GOV-SECRET-001 changed-file scanner false positive so the mandatory gates (pytest GOV-PACKAGING-003, pre-commit, CI governance/enforce) pass for this file. Verified with the installed code2llm DFGExtractor mutation grouping on the file's AST (standalone extract, since ProjectAnalyzer.analyze on copies/worktrees silently yields empty scopes): baseline reports an 'ide' mutation group of exactly 5 scopes matching the ticket's 'spans 5 functions'; after the refactor 'ide' has 0 scopes, from_chain 2, family_ide / env_ide / focused_ide_id / alias 1 each, and no group other than the pre-existing 'normalized' (6 scopes, separate variable) reaches the >= 5 threshold.
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket commit; the generic 'ide' locals return and the smell report returns.
